name: mcp-unifi
description: MCP server for self-hosted UniFi gateway management.
long_description: Self-hosted UniFi gateway management: VLANs, WLANs, firewall, clients, DHCP, observability, UniFi Protect cameras, and UniFi Access doors / credentials / badge events. Multi-site, dry-run on destructive ops, replayable audit log. Stub mode lets you try the 86 tools with no hardware.

stub_mode.title: Stub Mode
stub_mode.description: When enabled, the server returns realistic mock data and requires no UniFi hardware. Great for trying things out before pointing at a real gateway.

unifi_host.title: UniFi Host
unifi_host.description: IP address or hostname of your UniFi OS gateway (e.g. 192.168.1.1). Only required when Stub Mode is off.

unifi_api_key.title: UniFi API Key
unifi_api_key.description: Local API key from Settings -> Control Plane -> Integrations. Only required when Stub Mode is off.

modules_enabled.title: Modules Enabled
modules_enabled.description: Comma-separated list of modules to load. Options: network, protect, access. Default loads Network only. Access is read-only in v0.10.
